Bombay High Court Criticizes BMC Over Temporary Road Cleaning

The Bombay High Court has criticized the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for conducting temporary road cleaning operations, describing it as a 'two-day show' specifically before visits by dignitaries, including royals. The court questioned why such efforts were limited to VIPs and urged the BMC to maintain cleanliness year-round, rather than just for special occasions.
